reader.requirement: At 1985, when an OCCURS ... DEPENDING ON data-name-1 is written in a record description entry that contains the EXTERNAL clause, data-name-1 must be an item with the external attribute (in an EXTERNAL working-storage record, the same or another, or in a record of an EXTERNAL file, §1985:II.6.2.2.2.3) described in the same program's Data Division; an internal object (working-storage, linkage, a non-external file's record) or an external item described in a containing program is refused, and a fixed OCCURS needs no object. The witness covers part of the refusal half.
reader.edition-search: grep for Year, DialectLevel, SubscriptedClauseOperands, CobolVersion in OdoResolvePass.cs and DataBinder.Odo.cs: DependingAttributeFault and IsDescribedInContainer switch on nothing edition-specific; binder.Edition.Error is the diagnostic sink only. The rule is one edition-invariant check (the 2023 SR21 and the 1985 SR8 read alike).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the attribute mismatch; an object in another EXTERNAL record or an EXTERNAL file's record, LINKAGE and file-section objects, the containing-program object and the runtime extent shared across programs are not exercised

probes.expected: objects in the same EXTERNAL record, another EXTERNAL 01, and an EXTERNAL file's record are accepted; the extent follows the object, and the contained program sharing EXT-A sees the same object and extent

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR8  (5.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR8
OK  §1985:II.6.2.2.2.3  (6.2.2.2.3 Record Areas for Files)  the text is in the clause

reader.notes: OdoResolvePass.Run asks DependingAttributeFault for every ODO object: the table record's own EXTERNAL clause is the trigger, IsInExternalRecord (EXTERNAL working-storage records and records of EXTERNAL files) the object's attribute, and IsDescribedInContainer the 'same Data Division' half. A table in an EXTERNAL file's record with an internal object is accepted, reading SR8's 'record description entry containing the EXTERNAL clause' literally; that is the one interpretive point. Diagnostics cite §2023:13.18.38.3 SR21 (wording only).

refuter.evidence: r6-fwd.cob at --std 85 (EXIT 0): an ODO table in EXT-A whose object B-N lives in a LATER EXTERNAL 01 (EXT-B) is accepted and printed '[ABC]' with B-N = 3, so the extent follows the external object. r6-77.cob: a 77-level internal object for a table in an EXTERNAL record is refused (COBOL2788 'does not possess the external attribute'). cite.py: 'OK §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR8 the text is in SR8'. The reader accepts a table in an EXTERNAL file's record with an internal object (c6-c1-extfd). That reads SR8's 'record description entry containing the EXTERNAL clause' literally: an FD-level EXTERNAL is not in the record description entry. The literal text supports it, so it is not grounds to overturn.
